subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The king then took the pearls from him and handed it to another of his court officials and ordered to crush the pearl. (b) In this manner, one by one the king called sixty-five officials from his government and every one of them followed the example set by the minister and got rewarded. (c) One day Sultan Mahmood called together the officials of his government with the aim of testing their intelligence. (d) The minister refused to crush the pearl saying that it was more valuable and to crush the pearl meant to disrespect the treasury to the kingdom. (e) He look out a pearl from his treasury and handed it to one of his ministers and ordered to crush the pearl into pieces. (f) The officer also showed unwillingness to crush the pearl saying that it worthed half of the kingdom. At this the king became glad and rewarded him. (g) At last when Ayaaz, close one to the king, was ordered to crush the pearl, he did it instantly and said "The command of the king is more valuable than the precious pearl." At this the king became very glad and showed the reason of Ayaaz's closeness to the king. (h) The King applauded this reply and rewarded the minister with a royal robe of honour. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (c) + (e) + (d) + (a) + (g) + (b) + (h) + (g) First Paper  Solutions Section B : Writing Test
